name: Koala AI
tagline: AI SEO writer that turns a keyword into a ranking article.
description: Koala AI is a content suite built around KoalaWriter, which generates publish-ready long-form articles using real-time SERP analysis to fold in the keywords, topics, and entities top results rank for. It pairs with KoalaChat, KoalaImages, internal-linking, and lead-magnet tools, and publishes directly to WordPress, Shopify, Webflow, and Ghost. A limited free trial precedes paid plans starting at $9/month.

modelSupport.notes: Choose between GPT and Claude models for generation.

edge: Bakes live SERP analysis into one-click long-form drafts, so articles ship keyword- and entity-optimized out of the box.

references.title: KoalaWriter AI Review - The Best One-Click SEO AI Writer
